tools.name: save_memory
tools.description: Save or update a named memory entry. Use this to remember facts about the user that are likely to be relevant in future sessions — such as their name, preferences, ongoing projects, or recurring topics. Do not save temporary details or things only relevant to the current conversation.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name for this memory entry. Used as the filename, so keep it lowercase with underscores (e.g. 'user_name', 'preferred_language', 'project_context').

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: The content to remember. Can be multiple sentences. Limit to {config.maxContentLength} characters; content beyond this will be truncated.

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.description: Read a saved memory entry by name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the memory entry to recall.

tools.name: delete_memory
tools.description: Delete a saved memory entry by name.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the memory entry to delete.

tools.name: list_memories
tools.description: List the names of all saved memory entries without returning their full content.

tools.name: search_memories
tools.description: Search all memory entries for a keyword. Returns matching entry names and the lines that contain the keyword.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The keyword or phrase to search for (case-insensitive).
